modules.title: Understanding Check: Topic Overview & Objectives
modules.script: Let's pause here for a quick concept check on Topic Overview & Objectives. If a car travels 60 miles in 1 hour, what does the speedometer show when cruising at that steady pace?

checkpoint_question.question_text: If a car travels 60 miles in 1 hour, what does the speedometer show when cruising at that steady pace?
checkpoint_question.explanation: Steady rate of change is 60 miles divided by 1 hour, which equals 60 miles per hour.

misconception_distractors.C: Multiplied time instead of dividing distance by time.
